prereqs: Autodesk Fusion (Mac or Windows) with the repo addon copied into the Fusion API/AddIns folder and started (Shift+S, Add-Ins, Fusion360MCP, Run). Requires an Autodesk account; Fusion is free for educators and students under the Autodesk Education plan, or Personal use license.
claude_code_command: claude mcp add fusion360 -- uvx fusion360-mcp-server --mode socket
note: Placeholders only. Never commit real keys; keep secrets in .env or the OS keychain.
